HOOLHEYAKMOD-BIBLIOTHECA.title: "Bibliotheca"
HOOLHEYAKMOD-BIBLIOTHECA.description: At the start of combat, gain [blue]2[/blue] Analysis.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-BIBLIOTHECA.flavor: Memories are like a library, though obviously, the collection size of each library varies.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-BIBLIOTHECA.short_descripti: At the start of combat, gain [blue]2[/blue] Analysis.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-FRENZIED_SUNDIAL.title: Frenzied Sundial
HOOLHEYAKMOD-FRENZIED_SUNDIAL.descriptio: At the start of your turn, gain [E] and enter a random [gold]Aspect[/gold].
HOOLHEYAKMOD-FRENZIED_SUNDIAL.short_desc: At the start of your turn, gain [E] and enter a random [gold]Aspect[/gold].
HOOLHEYAKMOD-STAR_MAP_PROJECTION.title: Star Map Projection
HOOLHEYAKMOD-STAR_MAP_PROJECTION.descrip: Most [gold]Variables[/gold] can cost an additional [E] to trigger all effects simultaneously.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-STAR_MAP_PROJECTION.flavor: For many, the initial reason for getting into astrology is simply curiosity about their time of death.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-STAR_MAP_PROJECTION.short_d: Most [gold]Variables[/gold] can cost an additional [E] to trigger all effects simultaneously.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-OLD_NOTES.title: Old Notes
HOOLHEYAKMOD-OLD_NOTES.description: Whenever you draw [blue]5[/blue] Attack cards, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Erudition[/gold]; whenever you draw [blue]5[/blue] Skill cards, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Meander[/gold].
HOOLHEYAKMOD-OLD_NOTES.flavor: It records many precious documents. As for how they were collected...
HOOLHEYAKMOD-OLD_NOTES.short_description: Whenever you draw [blue]5[/blue] Attack cards, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Erudition[/gold]; whenever you draw [blue]5[/blue] Skill cards, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Meander[/gold].
HOOLHEYAKMOD-TIME_MUSEUM.title: Time Gallery of K'uk'ulkan
HOOLHEYAKMOD-TIME_MUSEUM.description: The first time you play each type of card each combat, play it [blue]1[/blue] additional time.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-TIME_MUSEUM.flavor: Fools build high walls, philosophers tear them down, and vice versa... History is a fascinating database, inevitably hiding revelations for the future. After all, history was once the future for countless generations.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-TIME_MUSEUM.short_descripti: The first time you play each type of card each combat, play it [blue]1[/blue] additional time.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-COCKTAIL_SHAKER.title: Cocktail Shaker
HOOLHEYAKMOD-COCKTAIL_SHAKER.description: Upon pickup, Max HP + [blue]3[/blue]. Whenever you play [blue]1[/blue] card of a different color, heal [blue]1[/blue] HP.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-COCKTAIL_SHAKER.short_descr: Upon pickup, Max HP + [blue]3[/blue]. Whenever you play [blue]1[/blue] card of a different color, heal [blue]1[/blue] HP.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-TAIL_CARE_KIT.title: Tail Care Kit
HOOLHEYAKMOD-TAIL_CARE_KIT.description: At the start of combat, apply [blue]7[/blue] [gold]Deconstruction[/gold] to all enemies.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-TAIL_CARE_KIT.flavor: "Are you team thick tail or team thin tail?"
HOOLHEYAKMOD-TAIL_CARE_KIT.short_descrip: At the start of combat, apply [blue]7[/blue] [gold]Deconstruction[/gold] to all enemies.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-BEAUTIFUL_HISTORY_BOOK.desc:
Enemies defeated previously in this run lose [blue]50%[/blue] of their Max HP at the start of combat.
(Right-click to view the list.)
HOOLHEYAKMOD-BEAUTIFUL_HISTORY_BOOK.flav: The same trick won't work twice on a smart person.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-BEAUTIFUL_HISTORY_BOOK.shor:
Enemies defeated previously in this run lose [blue]50%[/blue] of their Max HP at the start of combat.
(Right-click to view the list.)
HOOLHEYAKMOD-ASTRONOMICAL_TELESCOPE.desc: Upon pickup, randomly transform [blue]1[/blue] Strike or Defend in your deck into a Colorless card. If you have no basic cards, obtain [blue]1[/blue] random [gold]Rare[/gold] Colorless card.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-ASTRONOMICAL_TELESCOPE.flav: Those constellations, planets, and trajectories are not commands, but metaphors.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-ASTRONOMICAL_TELESCOPE.shor: Upon pickup, randomly transform [blue]1[/blue] Strike or Defend in your deck into a Colorless card. If you have no basic cards, obtain [blue]1[/blue] random [gold]Rare[/gold] Colorless card.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-BOTTLED_CLOUD.title: Bottled Cloud
HOOLHEYAKMOD-BOTTLED_CLOUD.flavor: "Great, now I can double jump even better."
HOOLHEYAKMOD-WEATHER_BALLOON.title: Weather Balloon
HOOLHEYAKMOD-WEATHER_BALLOON.description: When an enemy triggers [gold]Levitate[/gold], gain [blue]5[/blue] additional [gold]Lift[/gold].
HOOLHEYAKMOD-WEATHER_BALLOON.flavor: "Seeking to rival the heavens in height."
HOOLHEYAKMOD-WEATHER_BALLOON.short_descr: When an enemy triggers [gold]Levitate[/gold], gain [blue]5[/blue] additional [gold]Lift[/gold].
HOOLHEYAKMOD-ZODIAC_MODEL.title: Zodiac Model
HOOLHEYAKMOD-ZODIAC_MODEL.description: When an enemy's intent is different from the previous turn, apply [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Lift[/gold] to them.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-ZODIAC_MODEL.flavor: Feathers dampened by forest dew, tail sweeping past ruined stone pillars, knowledge is passed down through generations.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-ZODIAC_MODEL.short_descript: When an enemy's intent is different from the previous turn, apply [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Lift[/gold] to them.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-STARRY_REVELATION.title: Galleria Stellaria's Splendor
HOOLHEYAKMOD-STARRY_REVELATION.descripti: At the start of Elite or Boss combats, apply [gold]Lift[/gold] to all enemies equal to half their [gold]Gravity[/gold].
HOOLHEYAKMOD-STARRY_REVELATION.flavor: Trimounts' firmament has been restored to its original state, but surely no one can forget the sight after it was torn open.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-STARRY_REVELATION.short_des: At the start of Elite or Boss combats, apply [gold]Lift[/gold] to all enemies equal to half their [gold]Gravity[/gold].
HOOLHEYAKMOD-PURE_WATER_SPRITE_ASSIST.de: At the start of combat, summon [blue]1[/blue] Flowing Shape with [blue]16[/blue] HP. Enemies are forced to attack the Fluid Form while it is alive. [blue]3[/blue] turns after the Fluid Form dies, it resurrects with full HP.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-PURE_WATER_SPRITE_ASSIST.fl: "Let's be clear beforehand, just this once."
HOOLHEYAKMOD-PURE_WATER_SPRITE_ASSIST.sh: At the start of combat, summon [blue]1[/blue] Flowing Shape with [blue]16[/blue] HP. Enemies are forced to attack the Fluid Form while it is alive. [blue]3[/blue] turns after the Fluid Form dies, it resurrects with full HP.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-EYES_OF_PRIESTESS.title: Eyes of the Priestess
HOOLHEYAKMOD-EYES_OF_PRIESTESS.descripti: Whenever you draw cards at the start of your turn after shuffling your deck, look at the top [blue]5[/blue] cards of your draw pile and select up to [blue]5[/blue] cards. Variable: [gold]Discard them[/gold] ; [gold]Place them at the bottom of your draw pile[/gold].
HOOLHEYAKMOD-EYES_OF_PRIESTESS.flavor: Entering your dreams, shaping your dreams.
HOOLHEYAKMOD-EYES_OF_PRIESTESS.short_des: Whenever you draw cards at the start of your turn after shuffling your deck, look at the top [blue]5[/blue] cards of your draw pile and select up to [blue]5[/blue] cards. Variable: [gold]Discard them[/gold] ; [gold]Place them at the bottom of your draw pile[/gold].
